text: Ko ɓen kadi woni muññoriiɓe ɗoftagol Alla ngol, e ko Alla hoddirani ɓe kon woni moƴƴere maa bone, ɓe salii yeddugol Mo ngol ɗaɓɓugol welayee Alla, ɓe timminiri julde nden haaniri, ɓe nafqiri jawle ɗe Men yeɗi ɓe ɗen no haaniri, ɓe suuɗiri ngol nafku- gol kulol yiingo, ɓe feññiri ɗum fii no woɗɓe ñemtinira ɓe. Hino jeyaa e kelɗere maɓɓe, duñirgol bone boniiɗo e maɓɓe on moƴƴagol e makko. Ɓe siforiiɓe ɗin sifaaji, hino woodani ɓe galle yettiniiɗi Ñalnde Darngal.
